text: A cathedral or a communal house symbolized the grandeur of an organism of which every mason and stone-cutter was the builder, and a medieval building appears, not as a solitary effort to which thousands of slaves would have contributed the share assigned them by one man's imagination; all the city contributed to it.
author: Peter Kropotkin
reference: Mutual Aid: A Factor of Evolution
locator: Chapter VI, Mutual Aid in the Mediaeval City (continued)
